# Morning Desk Briefing

A Claude Code **skill**. Chains four data pulls — inventory aging, overdue collections, open negotiations, and quotes awaiting response — into a single "what needs my attention today?" report for the lab-grown diamond wholesale desk.

## Layout

```
skills/morning-briefing/
├── SKILL.md                       # skill frontmatter + instructions Claude reads
├── scripts/
│   └── morning_briefing.py        # data pipeline + CLI
├── install.sh                     # copies skill into .claude/skills/ to activate
└── README.qmd                     # this file
```

## What it does

The script runs four independent data pulls every morning:

1. **Inventory aging actions** — Finds all available stones aged ≥ 90 days. Tags each as CLEAR (≥ 180d) or DISCOUNT (90–179d), weighted against recent demand. Returns the stones needing the most urgent action first.

2. **Collection alerts** — From all open and partial invoices, surfaces every invoice more than 30 days past due. Sorted by `days_past_due` descending so the most critical debts appear first.

3. **Open negotiations** — Lists every negotiation thread still in `Open` status, sorted by `last_message_date` ascending (oldest = most neglected = top priority).

4. **Quotes awaiting response** — Finds Pending quotes where the customer has already countered (i.e. `customer_offer` is not null). These are deals the desk has left on the table.

## Activate it

```bash
bash skills/morning-briefing/install.sh
```

Restart Claude Code (or open a new session) to activate. After that, saying **"what needs my attention today?"** triggers this skill automatically.

## Running directly

```bash
# Default briefing (top 5 per section)
uv run python skills/morning-briefing/scripts/morning_briefing.py

# Show top 10 rows in each section
uv run python skills/morning-briefing/scripts/morning_briefing.py --top 10

# Add LLM-synthesized 3-5 bullet action summary
uv run python skills/morning-briefing/scripts/morning_briefing.py --model api-llama-4-scout

# JSON output (for piping into other tools)
uv run python skills/morning-briefing/scripts/morning_briefing.py --json

# Save inventory + invoice charts as PNGs
uv run python skills/morning-briefing/scripts/morning_briefing.py \
    --chart-out morning_briefing_chart.png

# Reproducible run pinned to a past date
uv run python skills/morning-briefing/scripts/morning_briefing.py \
    --today 2026-04-25

# Custom data directory
uv run python skills/morning-briefing/scripts/morning_briefing.py \
    --data-dir /path/to/custom/data
```

## Output format

```
=== Morning Desk Briefing — 2026-05-04 ===

INVENTORY (84 CLEAR | 293 DISCOUNT of 654 available)
  LGSTK00350 — Radiant 3.00+ DEF SI — 364d — CLEAR (−22% suggested)
  LGSTK00043 — Oval 2.00-2.99 GH VVS+ — 364d — CLEAR
  ... (top 5 shown)

COLLECTIONS (132 critical | $756,919 total outstanding)
  INV00323 — CUST0078 — $1,462 — 151 days overdue
  ... (top 5 shown)

NEGOTIATIONS (14 open threads)
  Thread THRD00002 — CUST0012 / LGSTK00518 — last activity 156 days ago
  ... (top 5 shown)

QUOTES AWAITING RESPONSE (7 quotes)
  QTE00045 — CUST0031 — offered $48 (our price $51)
  ... (top 5 shown)

--- LLM Summary (api-llama-4-scout) ---
• Clear LGSTK00350 immediately — 364 days on hand with weak demand.
• ...
```

## Charts

When `--chart-out` is passed, two PNG files are saved:

- `morning_briefing_chart_inventory.png` — Horizontal bar chart of stone counts by triage tag (CLEAR / DISCOUNT / WATCH / HOLD).
- `morning_briefing_chart_invoices.png` — Horizontal bar chart of invoice counts by aging bucket (Critical 60+d / Overdue 31–60d / Aging 8–30d).

## Running tests

```bash
uv run pytest tests/skills/test_morning_briefing.py -v
```
